require 'socket'
require 'digest'
require 'json'

module DistCache
  class Configuration
    attr_accessor :max_key_size, :max_value_size, :pool_size,
                  :serializer, :compression_threshold,
                  :retry_count, :socket_timeout, :namespace

    MAX_ALLOWED_VALUE_SIZE = 10_485_760  # 10MB hard cap
    MAX_ALLOWED_RETRIES = 5

    def initialize
      @max_key_size = [ENV.fetch('DCACHE_MAX_KEY', '250').to_i, 1024].min
      @max_value_size = [ENV.fetch('DCACHE_MAX_VALUE', '1048576').to_i, MAX_ALLOWED_VALUE_SIZE].min
      @pool_size = [ENV.fetch('DCACHE_POOL_SIZE', '5').to_i, 20].min
      @compression_threshold = ENV.fetch('DCACHE_COMPRESS_THRESHOLD', '1024').to_i
      @retry_count = [ENV.fetch('DCACHE_RETRIES', '3').to_i, MAX_ALLOWED_RETRIES].min
      @socket_timeout = ENV.fetch('DCACHE_TIMEOUT', '2').to_f
      @namespace = ENV.fetch('DCACHE_NAMESPACE', 'app')
      @serializer = :json
    end

    def frame_buffer_size
      # Protocol frame: header(8) + key + value + metadata(64)
      # Capped to prevent excessive allocation
      header_size = 8
      metadata_size = 64
      [@max_key_size + @max_value_size + header_size + metadata_size, MAX_ALLOWED_VALUE_SIZE + 1024].min
    end
  end

  class ProtocolFrame
    MAGIC = 0xDC_AC_HE_00
    VERSION = 1

    attr_reader :opcode, :key, :value, :flags, :expiry

    def initialize(opcode:, key: '', value: '', flags: 0, expiry: 0)
      @opcode = opcode
      @key = key
      @value = value
      @flags = flags
      @expiry = expiry
    end

    def serialize(config)
      key_bytes = @key.encode('UTF-8').bytes
      val_bytes = @value.bytes

      # Build frame on stack-allocated buffer concept
      # Total frame size computed from components
      total_len = 8 + key_bytes.length + val_bytes.length + 16

      header = [
        VERSION,
        @opcode,
        key_bytes.length,
        val_bytes.length,
        @flags,
        @expiry,
        total_len
      ].pack('CCnNnNn')

      header + key_bytes.pack('C*') + val_bytes.pack('C*')
    end
  end

  class ConnectionPool
    def initialize(host, port, config)
      @host = host
      @port = port
      @config = config
      @connections = []
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @allocated_buffer_size = config.frame_buffer_size
    end

    def with_connection
      conn = checkout
      yield conn
    ensure
      checkin(conn) if conn
    end

    private

    def checkout
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @connections.pop || create_connection
      end
    end

    def checkin(conn)
      @mutex.synchronize do
        if @connections.length < @config.pool_size
          @connections.push(conn)
        else
          conn.close rescue nil
        end
      end
    end

    def create_connection
      sock = Socket.new(Socket::AF_INET, Socket::SOCK_STREAM)
      sockaddr = Socket.sockaddr_in(@port, @host)
      sock.connect(sockaddr)
      sock
    end
  end

  class Client
    OPCODES = { get: 0x01, set: 0x02, delete: 0x03, incr: 0x04 }

    def initialize(servers: ['127.0.0.1:11211'], config: nil)
      @config = config || Configuration.new
      @pools = build_pools(servers)
      @ring = build_hash_ring(servers)
    end

    def get(key)
      namespaced = apply_namespace(key)
      validate_key!(namespaced)
      pool = pool_for(namespaced)

      pool.with_connection do |conn|
        frame = ProtocolFrame.new(opcode: OPCODES[:get], key: namespaced)
        send_frame(conn, frame)
        read_response(conn)
      end
    end

    def set(key, value, expiry: 0, flags: 0)
      namespaced = apply_namespace(key)
      validate_key!(namespaced)
      serialized = serialize_value(value)
      validate_value!(serialized)

      pool = pool_for(namespaced)

      pool.with_connection do |conn|
        frame = ProtocolFrame.new(
          opcode: OPCODES[:set],
          key: namespaced,
          value: serialized,
          flags: flags,
          expiry: expiry
        )
        send_frame(conn, frame)
        read_response(conn)
      end
    end

    def delete(key)
      namespaced = apply_namespace(key)
      validate_key!(namespaced)
      pool = pool_for(namespaced)

      pool.with_connection do |conn|
        frame = ProtocolFrame.new(opcode: OPCODES[:delete], key: namespaced)
        send_frame(conn, frame)
        read_response(conn)
      end
    end

    private

    def apply_namespace(key)
      "#{@config.namespace}:#{key}"
    end

    def validate_key!(key)
      if key.bytesize > @config.max_key_size
        raise ArgumentError, "Key too large: #{key.bytesize} > #{@config.max_key_size}"
      end
    end

    def validate_value!(value)
      if value.bytesize > @config.max_value_size
        raise ArgumentError, "Value too large: #{value.bytesize} > #{@config.max_value_size}"
      end
    end

    def serialize_value(value)
      case @config.serializer
      when :json
        JSON.generate(value)
      else
        value.to_s
      end
    end

    def send_frame(conn, frame)
      data = frame.serialize(@config)
      write_with_retry(conn, data, @config.retry_count)
    end

    def write_with_retry(conn, data, retries_remaining)
      # Iterative retry - no recursive stack growth
      attempts = 0
      begin
        conn.write(data)
      rescue Errno::EAGAIN, Errno::EWOULDBLOCK
        attempts += 1
        if attempts <= retries_remaining
          sleep(0.01 * (2 ** attempts))
          retry
        else
          raise
        end
      end
    end

    def read_response(conn)
      header = conn.read(8)
      return nil unless header && header.length == 8

      _ver, _op, _klen, vlen, _flags, _exp, _total = header.unpack('CCnNnNn')
      
      if vlen > 0 && vlen <= @config.max_value_size
        body = conn.read(vlen)
        deserialize_value(body)
      end
    end

    def deserialize_value(data)
      return nil unless data
      case @config.serializer
      when :json
        JSON.parse(data)
      else
        data
      end
    end

    def pool_for(key)
      hash = Digest::MD5.hexdigest(key).to_i(16)
      index = hash % @pools.length
      @pools[index]
    end

    def build_pools(servers)
      servers.map do |server|
        host, port = server.split(':')
        ConnectionPool.new(host, port.to_i, @config)
      end
    end

    def build_hash_ring(servers)
      servers.flat_map do |server|
        (0..39).map { |i| Digest::MD5.hexdigest("#{server}-#{i}") }
      end.sort
    end
  end
end
